description: Fetch and extract content from a web page. Returns the page content in markdown format.

live.description: Fetch the page live from the source instead of returning Keenable's indexed copy. Use it for pages that change often or URLs that are not indexed.

max_chars.description: Hard cap on the characters of returned page content. Longer pages are cut to fit, ending with "..." unless max_chars is 3 or less, and the output says how long the full page is. Lower it to save context on long pages. When omitted, up to 50000 characters are returned.

output_format.description: Response format: 'text' for readable text, or 'json' for the raw response serialized as JSON when you need to parse fields programmatically.

prompt.description: Extraction instruction for this page. When set, an LLM reads the fetched page and the returned content is only the output for this instruction instead of the full page; use it when you need one detail from a long page. Example: "List all pricing tiers with their monthly prices".

session_id.description: Id of the agent session making this call. Send the same value on every call in one session so its requests can be grouped.

name: fetch_page_content
